subject: Post-demo: stakeholder influence map + sourcing next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@aurelia-fin.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@aurelia-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: stakeholder influence map + sourcing next steps

Hi Sarah and Tom — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a pragmatic next-step plan so we keep momentum toward procurement: 

What we heard (short):
- Primary decision criteria: predictable latency at 95th percentile, deterministic cost per 1M tokens, and a clear security/data partitioning model.
- Key stakeholders we identified on today’s call:
  - Economic buyer: Tom Chen (VP Eng) — owns budget approval and vendor selection economics
  - Security/compliance: Sarah Lee — will own SOC2 and data retention/security gating
  - Procurement/legal: Michael Ortiz (procurement lead) — handles PO, contracts, and SOW
  - Engineering champion(s): (you mentioned two infra leads) — will validate perf and integration

Recommended next steps (by owner & rough dates):
1) Redwood: send two artifacts — a focused econ worksheet (unit economics at 1M/10M tokens) and our security checklist (SOC2 scope, data retention, KMS options). — Owner: Tessa — by EOD 19-May.
2) Aurelia: confirm procurement contact and preferred contracting model (purchase order vs SOW + invoice cadence). — Owner: Tom — by 21-May.
3) Joint: 30-min procurement + security sync to map gating items and calendar (ideally next week). Proposal: Thu 2027-05-20 10:00 PT / alternate Fri 2027-05-21 11:00 PT.

I've attached the econ worksheet and the security checklist as a starting point (see attachments).

Ask for you: please confirm the procurement contact (Michael?) and whether your legal team needs any NDAs or specific flow for redlines ahead of a procurement meeting.

Thanks — we’ll keep the ask light: aim to get procurement comfortable with SOW terms and a clear born-dates map for proof-of-concept (30 days) vs production rollout.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0147
attachments: redwood-economic-worksheet-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-security-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Thanks, Tessa — good summary. A couple quick clarifications from security side: 

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 3:02 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah and Tom — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a pragmatic next-step plan so we keep momentum toward procurement:
> ...

Questions from my team:
- SOC2: do you have a SOC2 Type II report we can review, or an attestation timeline if you’re in progress?
- Data separation: we need specifics on tenant isolation for embeddings and any customer-managed KMS options.
- Retention: Aurelia’s policy requires a clear default retention period and an emergency purge process; can you outline options?

We have Michael (cc) as our procurement lead; he’ll take the lead on contracting logistics. Tom — I can coordinate an initial security + procurement slot; the proposed Thu 10:00 PT looks feasible for me.

—Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Security Engineering, Aurelia Financial

If Thu 5/20 10:00 PT is still our best shot, I’ll set a calendar invite after Marissa confirms the security pack is ready. Otherwise propose Fri 5/21 11:00 PT.
